children: Iron ore futures fall in early Asian trading. Prices are likely to remain rangebound at low levels in the near term, says Baocheng Futures in a research note. Overall supply pressure remains intact while construction demand is still sluggish. Any meaningful rebound hinges on supply-side contractions, it says. The most-traded iron ore contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange is down 1.25% at CNY673.0 a ton. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
